dialect.detail: IBM mainframe COBOL subprogram, likely compiled with IBM Enterprise COBOL; Italian-language comments, authored by Accenture, references CICS COMMAREA pattern (AREA-IDSV0001), DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA, commented-out IBM-370 compiler directives
evidence: EXEC CICS comment reference in COMMAREA naming

purpose.domain_detail: Italian enterprise application error-message formatting utility; substitutes placeholder parameters (delimited by '$') in extended error description strings, used exclusively by routine IEAS9900
purpose.summary: IEAS9800 is a COBOL subprogram that parses a semicolon-delimited parameter string and substitutes positional '$'-prefixed placeholders in an extended error description string. It is called by IEAS9900 and returns the formatted error description via an output linkage area. The program handles both sequential and indexed parameter substitution.

notable_features: LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAREA pattern (AREA-IDSV0001) suggesting CICS context
COPY statements for IDSV0001, IEAI9801, IEAO9801
OCCURS 10 TIMES table for parameter list
Inline sequence-tag comments (SET06, OTT06) indicating change history
GOBACK after EXIT in main paragraph
verdict.notes: All comments are in Italian; authored by Accenture, dated 2006. The COPY members (IDSV0001, IEAI9801, IEAO9801) are not expanded in the source so full data layout is not visible. The program appears to be part of a larger Italian enterprise system. No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS statements despite being labeled 'ROUTINE COBOL-DB2' in comments.
